title: Screenshot a selected region on Wayland
summary: Interactively select a part of the screen to capture. This requires the 'slurp' tool to be installed.

steps.explain: Use slurp to interactively select a region on the screen, then pass that geometry to grim to capture it.

placeholders.name: FILE_PATH
placeholders.description: The path where the screenshot will be saved.

steps.expect: Your cursor changes to a crosshair; after selecting an area, the screenshot is saved to the specified file.
